headline: Sales and operating profit jump, per-share earnings fall
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 1.58T, up 53% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 525.3B, up 74% y/y, for a margin of about 33%. Yahoo EPS fell to KRW 327.
summary_long: Final results followed a preliminary report of about KRW 1.5T revenue and KRW 510B operating profit. No reported net income was found; Yahoo shard net income of KRW 75.0B and EPS of KRW 327 are far below operating profit and are not confirmed. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage. EPS is Yahoo data and could not be reconciled with reported profit; treat it with caution.
